title: TextMorph
tagline: System-wide, privacy-first autonomous device agent & floating AI companion for Android powered by local Gemma 4 & 3 inference
hero_description: A privacy-first Android assistant featuring an autonomous device agent that executes multi-step OS tasks via Code-as-Action, living floating companion overlays over any app, offline wake-word studio, and on-device Gemma 4 GPU inference.
showcase_subtitle: Explore TextMorph's autonomous multi-step device agent, living floating companion bubble across apps, offline wake-word studio, and hardware telemetry.
showcase_scroll_hint: Scroll or swipe to change screen

engines.title: Supported Local & API Inference Engines
engines.litert: Google LiteRT-LM (Gemma 4 Vision, Gemma 3 1B, mobile GPU acceleration, zero-copy mmap)
engines.llamacpp: llama.cpp Runtime (Universal GGUF quantized models on CPU/GPU)
engines.openai: OpenAI-Compatible APIs (Embedded Ktor server on 127.0.0.1:8080 and external endpoints)

arch_layer_1_tech: Jetpack Compose M3 + Floating Companion WindowManager
arch_layer_1_desc: Bespoke Charcoal Slate palette with living floating companion bubble anchored via WindowManager (FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE), full-width responsive dialogs, and tactile cards.
arch_layer_2_desc: Autonomous multi-step device task executor with deepest-leaf text matching, magnetic target snapping, click_element(id), precision reticle overlays, and SkillMemoryService.
arch_layer_3_desc: 100% offline keyword spotting for custom wake-words ("Computer", "Hey Tamim") with 3-attempt acoustic tuning studio, hardware hotkeys, and automated voice script runners.
arch_layer_4_tech: LiteRT-LM Gemma 4 Vision + Zero-Copy mmap + llama.cpp
arch_layer_4_desc: Hardware-accelerated mobile GPU inference supporting Google Gemma 4 (with Vision tokens) and Gemma 3 1B with zero-copy Linux mmap direct from /sdcard/Download.
arch_layer_5_desc: Asynchronous non-blocking HTTP server listening on 127.0.0.1:8080. Implements standard OpenAI /v1/models and streaming /v1/chat/completions for local edge automations.
arch_layer_6_tech: Live CPU/RAM/Thermal Profiler + Zero Process Death Contract
arch_layer_6_desc: Real-time on-device hardware profiler monitoring LiteRT-LM CPU load, RAM footprint (5.7GB), and thermals (38°C), paired with near-logging (AppLogger) and zero-crash contracts.

floating_agent.title: System-Wide Floating AI Agent
floating_agent.subtitle: Universal AccessibilityService & WindowManager Overlay Across Any App
floating_agent.desc: A living, intelligent floating companion widget anchored over any Android application. Powered by a non-intrusive AccessibilityService and WindowManager overlay (FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE), it lets you trigger autonomous agent workflows, voice missions, or instant screen analysis over WhatsApp, YouTube, Chrome, or Settings without switching apps.

autonomous_agent.title: Autonomous Agent Workspace
autonomous_agent.subtitle: Code-as-Action Multi-Step OS Navigation on Local Gemma 3 & 4
autonomous_agent.desc: Direct the local agent to automate real-world multi-step tasks across device apps. Using a Code-as-Action execution paradigm with deepest-leaf text matching, magnetic target snapping, and reticle overlays, it launches apps, inspects settings, searches feeds, and interacts with UI elements autonomously.

conversation_workspace.title: AI Conversation Workspace
conversation_workspace.subtitle: Dual Chat & Agent Switching with Local Context & Tool Integration
conversation_workspace.desc: An advanced conversational workspace featuring instant segmented switching between [Chat] and [Agent] modes. Direct local LiteRT-LM models to brainstorm, summarize, or debug, complete with user approval cards, follow-up suggestion chips, HTML sandbox rendering, and GIF trace export.

navigation_telemetry.title: Hardware Telemetry & Command Center
navigation_telemetry.subtitle: Live CPU, RAM & Thermals, Voice Automations & Wake-Word Studio
navigation_telemetry.desc: A slide-out command drawer featuring real-time on-device hardware telemetry (LiteRT CPU load, active RAM allocation, and thermal temperatures) alongside quick access to Voice Agent Missions, Custom Prompts, Offline Wake-Word Studio, and Agent Tools.

model_hub.title: Hardware-Accelerated Model Hub
model_hub.subtitle: Zero-Copy Linux mmap for Gemma 4 (Vision) & Gemma 3 LiteRT-LM
model_hub.desc: High-performance model manager supporting Gemma 4 (2.41GB / 3.41GB with Vision) and Gemma 3 (1B int4 at 557MB). Loads multi-gigabyte models directly from the user Downloads folder with zero file copying via Linux mmap and ParcelFileDescriptor, with OpenAI cloud fallbacks.
